Summary: Formation from admitted relationships only: co-presence becomes a labelled contextual lead (decision record step 5)
Description: 1) Original intent: Decision Record 2026-10-11 section 2 and step 5: formation consumes only admitted relationships present in the analytical snapshot; co-presence remains a discovery lead and never becomes structural proof or a formation member. 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) the formation is built from the admitted relationships in the displayed snapshot (the frozen view), with no input from the signal pool's co-presence; (b) two domains are linked only when one admitted relationship speaks to both, or a participant takes part in an admitted relationship of each; a link carries the ratified domain-pair type, the connecting entities and the relationship ids behind it; (c) no composite score is computed from admitted relationships (none carries a magnitude); (d) a subject with no admitted relationships, or relationships in one domain only, shows 'No formation established' with the reason, whatever the pool's co-presence says; (e) the pool's co-presence is shown only as labelled contextual leads (not admitted relationships, not a formation); (f) Analysis and MAP show the same formation; (g) the unnamed-affiliate qualification and evidence remain reachable from the link; (h) two entities, one registry-resolved and one admitted at runtime; thematic queries without an entity show no formation; existing suites green; the benchmark baseline untouched. 3) Current implementation state: built. admittedformation.js (pure), the brief's formation block and sentence, the MAP's formation input and a Formation row, the event-class domain map moved to eventdomains.js (re-exported by the 8-K connector). Tests: qa_admittedformation 12/12; live on three queries (qa_formation_live). 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1401 (admitted capital-event relationships), KRYL-1402 (durable store), KRYL-1398 (snapshot). The MAP v3 geometry and visuals are unchanged; three text labels and one row were changed in structure-field.html because their meaning changed (co-present pairs became admitted links). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (formation is structure from admitted relationships; Formation is not a verdict). Status: opened and built 2026-10-11.
